hook: Sony Pictures projected $7 million, but The Social Reckoning bombed with $5.5 million.

sections.voiceover: Sony Pictures projected $7 million, but The Social Reckoning bombed with $5.5 million.
b_roll: Movie theater marquee displaying ticket sales

sections.voiceover: Aaron Sorkin directed the Facebook-focused feature across North America. Friday previews brought in $2.1 million total for the studio. Where did ticket sales fall short for Sony Pictures?
Universal horror movie Other Mommy dominated the exact same weekend.
Jessica Chastain starred in that rival feature to capture $27.5 million. Sony Pictures lost the box office race completely during opening weekend.
